title: Earning Rule
description: Turns a booking into metric contributions for one program. Mirrors `EarningRule` in QualificationEngine/EarningRule.swift. File convention: `<id>.earning.json`.

honMetricId.description: HON Circle points metric, gated by honCabins.

qpIntegratedAirlines.description: Operating airlines (IATA) that earn qualifying/HON points.

honCabins.description: Cabins that earn HON Circle points.

pointsMetricId.description: Status-points metric, if the program awards them.

nightsMetricId.description: Nights metric, if the program counts nights.

staysMetricId.description: Stays metric (1 per stay regardless of nights).

pointsPerEuro.description: Points per eligible euro (only with pointsMetricId).

roundPointsDown.description: Floor vs nearest for points. Defaults to true.

pointsPerEuro.description: Points per spend unit (EUR unless convertToEUR is false).

roundPointsDown.description: Floor vs nearest for points. Defaults to true.

convertToEUR.description: Convert amount to EUR first (default true). Set false for currency-denominated points like BA Tier Points.
